Sweet yeast dough spiralled round foil-wrapped rolling pins, baked golden and rolled in cinnamon sugar and crushed walnuts, warm and chewy. Mix 300g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 40g sugar, 1 egg, 40g soft butter and 150ml warm milk into a soft dough, knead 5 minutes and prove 1 hour. Wrap 2 rolling pins in buttered foil. Roll the dough into long 1cm ropes and coil tightly around the pins. Brush with melted butter, roll in 100g sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon and 50g crushed walnuts, and bake at 200C for 15 minutes. Slide off and cut into rings.

the final fight at Tower Bridge

Flathead fillets in a crisp lager batter fried golden, with thick double-cooked chips, minted mushy peas and tartare sauce. Cut 1kg potatoes into thick chips and fry at 140C for 6 minutes, then drain. Whisk 200g self-raising flour with 300ml cold lager and salt. Dust 600g flathead fillets in flour, dip in the batter and fry at 180C for 4 minutes until crisp. Fry the chips again at 190C for 3 minutes. Simmer 400g frozen peas for 4 minutes, mash with butter and mint. Serve with tartare and lemon.
W: Savoiardi dipped in espresso, layered with mascarpone whipped with yolks, sugar and cream, set overnight, cocoa on top.
K: Fresh peach purée topped with sparkling apple juice, the alcohol-free take on Venice's own drink.

s.how: Toast baguette slices with olive oil. Whip 200g poached smoked cod with olive oil and garlic until creamy and spread on a third. Top a third with prosciutto and fresh fig, and the rest with marinated artichoke and parsley.

s.note: Peter and Happy in the tulip fields in the Netherlands
s.how: Cut 1kg potatoes into thick fries, rinse and dry. Fry at 140C until soft, rest, then fry at 190C until crisp. Toss with sea salt and pile into paper cones with a big spoon of mayonnaise on top, the Dutch way.

m.note: the class in Venice before the water monster hits
m.how: Soften crushed garlic and a pinch of chilli in olive oil. Add 250ml white wine, 300g green prawns, 500g mussels and 500g clams, cover and cook until the shells open. Toss through 500g cooked spaghetti with chopped parsley.

w.how: Whisk 3 yolks with 80g sugar until pale, then fold in 250g mascarpone and 200ml whipped cream. Dip savoiardi briefly in cooled strong coffee and layer with the cream in a dish. Repeat, chill overnight and dust with cocoa.

d.how: Blend 4 ripe peaches, peeled and stoned, with 1 tbsp sugar and a squeeze of lemon until smooth. Spoon 3 tbsp purée into each of 4 glasses and slowly top with 150ml chilled sparkling apple juice, stirring gently.
